speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Extensor Lag of the Distal Interphalangeal Joint).

The clinical picture of an inability to actively flex the distal interphalangeal joint, combined with pain and swelling in the right ring finger following a history of the finger being forced into hyperextension during a football tackle, is highly specific to this injury. This diagnosis is consistent with a rupture of the terminal extensor tendon or an avulsion fracture of the distal phalanx base.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
